run_pipeline_generate_video: run the HunyuanVideo15Pipeline to generate a video from a text prompt with configurable steps and dimensions
create_pipeline_encode_prompt: create text embeddings for video generation using the HunyuanVideo15Pipeline encode_prompt method with MLLM and ByT5 encoders
build_pipeline_prepare_latents: build noisy latent tensors for video generation with configurable batch size, frames, height, width, and device
test_pipeline_check_inputs: test input validation for the HunyuanVideo15Pipeline call method including prompt, dimensions, and embedding consistency checks
summarize_pipeline_retrieve_timesteps: summarize the retrieve_timesteps helper function that configures scheduler timesteps from num_inference_steps, custom timesteps, or sigmas
